task.description:
WF-03 Step 0.5 — Registry lookup, ISS file creation, and GitHub issue confirmation for GH-821.

GH-821 is already filed at https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/821 with title: 'tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig:177 uses hardcoded UUID (T010) instead of per-test generation'.

1. Search docs/issues/ for any existing ISS entry that matches this defect (hardcoded UUID in par02 test fixture).
2. If no ISS entry exists, create docs/issues/ISS-<next-N>.json with fields: id, title, github_issue, severity (MAJOR), status (OPEN), affected_file, root_cause_summary, created_at.
3. Confirm the GitHub issue GH-821 is open (it is — already confirmed).
4. Record the ISS ID in result.artifacts_out.
acceptance_criteria: An ISS entry exists in docs/issues/ for this defect
ISS entry has severity MAJOR (test isolation gate failure blocks CI)
result.artifacts_out contains the ISS file path
GitHub issue GH-821 is confirmed open (no action needed — already filed)

result.summary: Registry lookup found existing ISS-0718 (created 2026-08-17 in ADHOC-par02-03-05-release-20260817) covering this exact defect: hardcoded UUID at par02_partition_catalog_test.zig:177, T010 violation, already linked to https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/821 (GH-821, confirmed OPEN). No new ISS file required. GH-821 is confirmed open.
